extrathyroidal_extension.description: Pattern of extrathyroidal extension. 'none' = tumor confined to thyroid; 'strap_muscles' = invading only strap muscles (T3b); 'soft_tissue_or_larynx_trachea_esophagus_recurrent_nerve' = T4a invasion; 'prevertebral_or_carotid_mediastinum' = T4b invasion.

choices.strap_muscles: Strap muscles only (sternohyoid, sternothyroid, thyrohyoid, omohyoid) -- T3b
choices.soft_tissue_or_larynx_trachea_esophagus_: Subcutaneous soft tissues, larynx, trachea, esophagus, or recurrent laryngeal nerve -- T4a
choices.prevertebral_or_carotid_mediastinum: Prevertebral fascia or carotid/mediastinal vessels -- T4b

positive_node_count.description: Number of regional lymph nodes confirmed positive for metastasis.

node_region.description: Anatomic region of positive nodes when present.

display.label: Region of positive regional lymph nodes

choices.central_VI_VII: Central compartment: level VI or VII (pretracheal, paratracheal, prelaryngeal/Delphian, upper mediastinal) -- N1a
choices.lateral_I_II_III_IV_V_or_retropharyngeal: Lateral neck (levels I-V) or retropharyngeal -- N1b

node_cytology_benign.description: Cytologic / histologic confirmation of one or more BENIGN regional lymph nodes (drives N0a).

node_assessment_done.description: Whether locoregional nodal status has been clinically or radiologically assessed (drives N0b when no evidence found).

display.label: Locoregional nodal status was explicitly assessed

age_at_diagnosis_years.description: Patient age at the time of diagnosis. Differentiated thyroid AJCC 8 stage grouping is dichotomized at 55 years.

T.label: T4b: prevertebral fascia / carotid / mediastinal vessels
T4a: soft tissue / larynx / trachea / esophagus / recurrent laryngeal nerve
T3b: gross extension into strap muscles only (any size)

N.label: N1b: lateral neck or retropharyngeal nodes positive
N1a: central compartment (level VI/VII) nodes positive
N0b: no radiologic or clinical evidence of locoregional metastasis (explicit assessment)

Age.label: <55: age at diagnosis less than 55 years
>=55: age at diagnosis 55 years or older

examples.label: 3 cm confined, 2 central nodes positive, age 60 -> T2, N1a
5 cm confined, lateral neck positive, distant mets, age 70 -> T3a, N1b, M1
any size with prevertebral invasion, age 65 -> T4b
